wentWrong.what: At a large default font a link's target landed under the bar on big screens
wentWrong.evidence: Production, 2026-11-20: from 64rem the scroll padding was a fixed 56 px under a 3.5rem bar, so /#work landed at 56 under a bar ending at 70, 84 and 98 at 20, 24 and 28 px (1920 x 1200), up to 42 px of the section hidden

wentWrong.evidence: Probe's T41b on main: Shift+Tab scrolled the link's box to the padding, so its 4 px ring was 3.7 to 4.5 px under the bar at 16 px and up to 46.5 px at 28 px (/log at 2560 x 1440)
